name: Art only
description: Just the art of a card, for your own cards: cut out of its window (Scryfall's own cut-out for real cards), or – for full-art and borderless cards – with the name bar, type line, text box, P/T and border painted over by a content-aware fill that rebuilds them from the art around them (offline; AI fill too when AI is switched on). Adds Keep only the art to the Decklists page.
author: MEZTKING

page.title: Art only
page.tooltip: The art of a card without its frame and text
